definitions.explanation: The act of making something tighter, firmer, or more disciplined. Used for physical toning (body), financial austerity (budgets), and figurative tightening (discipline, security).

examples.japanese: ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started toning my body for summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規律|きりつ}→規律：00236_kiritsu⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{図|はか}られた→図る：12006_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: Following the scandal, efforts were made to tighten discipline within the company.

notes:
The noun form of {引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tighten, to firm up). Used across a wide range of contexts — from economics and policy to fitness and personal discipline.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め — monetary tightening
- ⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め — fiscal austerity
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め — body toning, firming up
- ⟦{規律|きりつ}→規律：00236_kiritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}め — tightening of discipline
- {引|ひ}き{締|し}め⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ — austerity measures

USAGE:
In economic news, {引|ひ}き{締|し}め typically refers to central bank policies that restrict money supply (raising interest rates, reducing lending). In fitness and beauty contexts, it refers to toning muscles or firming skin. In organizational contexts, it means enforcing stricter discipline.

RELATED WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{締|し}める — to tighten (the verb form)
- ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧ — easing, relaxation; the antonym in economic policy
- {締|し}め{付|つ}け — crackdown, restriction; harsher connotation
